meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: 启动一个并行安全审计团队:3 名漏洞猎手分头找候选漏洞,2 名 PoC 工程师复现或推翻,按实际可利用性定级,最后输出结论、发现表、被降级候选与剩余风险。
howto.when: 当你提出安全审查、漏洞审计等需求,或使用 /security-research 时触发;需要 team_* 工具可用、在主会话中运行,并给出具体目标(仓库、diff、PR 等)。

say.text: 对当前仓库做一次安全审计,重点看认证和数据隔离
say.note: 会创建 3 名猎手 + 2 名 PoC 的团队并行审查

say.text: 审计这个 PR 的 diff,找出可利用的漏洞并给 PoC
say.note: 对变更范围审查并按可利用性定级

say.text: /security-research 检查这次发布的候选版本

howto.what_en: Runs a parallel audit team: 3 vulnerability hunters find candidates, 2 PoC engineers reproduce or falsify them, severity is set by real exploitability, and you get a verdict, findings table, downgraded candidates and residual risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a security review, vulnerability audit, or /security-research. Requires team_* tools available, running in the main session, and a concrete target.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on this repo, focusing on auth and data isolation
say_en.note: Creates a team of 3 hunters and 2 PoC engineers

say_en.text: Audit this PR diff for exploitable vulnerabilities and give me a PoC
say_en.note: Reviews the change scope and scores by exploitability
Outputs PASS, PASS WITH FINDINGS, or BLOCK
